After the mysterious death of your beloved pet cat, you start questioning the reality of things around you. With murders picking up around the town, you started to isolate yourself in paranoia. The police don't believe you, they say they have more pressing matters to tend to. However, a beloved detective seems willing to help you out on the matter...

在你心爱的宠物猫神秘死亡后，你开始质疑周围事物的现实。随着镇上谋杀案的增多，你开始在偏执中孤立自己。警察不相信你，他们说他们有更紧迫的事情要处理。然而，一位心爱的侦探似乎愿意帮助你解决这件事……
